app_name: Scribbld ✳ People — Who's your Scribbld person?
design_philosophy: Tactile digital collage with paper textures, handmade tape overlays, doodle stickers, internet-native agency humor, bold neo-brutalist offset shadows, and smooth motion physics.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-heading leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight font-heading text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.tape_overlay: absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-20 h-6 bg-[rgba(254,240,138,0.75)] backdrop-blur-sm transform -rotate-2 border-y border-amber-300/40 z-20 pointer-events-none shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.sticker_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border-2 border-slate-900 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#1E1E24] bg-amber-300 text-slate-900 transform -rotate-1
visual_enhancers.neo_brutalist_card: bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1E1E24] hover:translate-x-[-1px] hover:translate-y-[-1px] transition-all

grids.mobile_container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F9F6F0] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-x-hidden border-x border-slate-200/60 shadow-xl

layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-[#F9F6F0]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b-2 border-slate-900 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
layouts.bottom_action_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-md bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t-2 border-slate-900 p-4 z-40 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-[0_-4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text over craft paper and card backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on all interactive buttons, card choices, and navigation tabs.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Check window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to disable intense card flips and floating stickers.
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive button, input, quiz option card, consent toggle, and match action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first 360px React application with full support for scaling on desktop screens.
Implement the 28 quiz questions broken into 5 sections with progress tracking, back/skip buttons, and autosave.

Build Microsoft SSO simulation -> Welcome -> Profile builder with image cropping -> 28 quiz screens -> Welcome note with word counter -> Consent screen -> Card flip reveal -> Profile card -> People to meet -> Say hi bottom sheet -> Inbox -> Settings -> Admin dashboard.
Utilize Framer Motion for smooth card slides, sticker animations, and card-flip personality reveal with canvas-confetti.
Ensure every interactive element has a unique `data-testid` attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients; use craft paper textures and neo-brutalist offset shadows.
Ensure readable APCA color contrast and explicit text colors on all hover states.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use sticker overlays and rotated paper cards.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
